title: Параллельные Миры (Союз WHILE)
description:
Вставь глаголы в Past Continuous.

С while обе части могут быть в Past Continuous, если два действия происходили одновременно в прошлом: was/were + verb-ing.

items.sentence: While I ___ (use) my laptop, my brother ___ (play) an online game.
While she ___ (talk) to her friend on a video call, her phone ___ (charge).
While we ___ (watch) a film online, our smart TV ___ (download) an update.
While they ___ (create) a presentation, the printer ___ (print) some documents.
While I ___ (look) for information on the Internet, my tablet ___ (update) its apps.
